episode_notes: A Telugu comedy web series following Prasad, an eccentric, shameless young man navigating awkward romantic encounters with Vaishu (Bhramara), Pooja, Pratheeksha, and Virajitha. After getting rejected repeatedly and finding out his love interests are either married, engaged, or related, he faces a surprise twist at the end. The final revelation in L0888-L0918, where Vaishu cancels her wedding to aggressively claim Prasad, would spoil the ending if clipped out of sequence.

episode_summary.episode_notes: A Telugu comedy web series following Prasad, an eccentric, shameless young man navigating awkward romantic encounters with Vaishu (Bhramara), Pooja, Pratheeksha, and Virajitha. After getting rejected repeatedly and finding out his love interests are either married, engaged, or related, he faces a surprise twist at the end. The final revelation in L0888-L0918, where Vaishu cancels her wedding to aggressively claim Prasad, would spoil the ending if clipped out of sequence.

moment_table.text: tea తో కలిసి బండి తాగేస్తాడా తాగబోతున్నా కొడుకు
moment_table.why: Told her match is a teetotaler, Prasad ridiculously misinterprets it as a drunkard who mixes brandy into tea.

moment_table.text: అప్పుడు సంబంధం పెళ్లి Bro cure చూడమన్నంగాన్నా RKEs department వాళ్ళకి అడగాలి తవకలో తేస్తారు మంచి అమ్మాయిని
moment_table.why: Prasad mocks the cliché of finding a better girl by quipping that he should hire the archaeology department to dig one up.

moment_table.text: పోన్లే మీ విడాకుల case మీరే వాదించుకోవచ్చు
moment_table.why: Hearing that Virajitha is marrying a lawyer too, Prasad cynically observes that they can argue their own divorce case.

moment_table.text: అలా అని చెప్పి నిన్ను వేరే జంతువుతో పోల్చలేను కదా
moment_table.why: After Virajitha compares him to a pig, Prasad exposes her ignorance of liquor brands and snaps back that he won't compare her to animals.

moment_table.text: లేదా నిన్నైనా చంపేస్తా
moment_table.why: Vaishu shocks Prasad by declaring her love through a psycho-possessive threat to either kill herself or murder him if he looks at anyone else.
